biw_news.title: Audi's Next A4 Delayed Until 2029 As VW's New EV Platform Falls Behind
biw_news.summary: Delays in Volkswagen's Scalable Systems Platform (SSP) directly impact the structural floorpan architecture and battery enclosure design for Audi's upcoming EV lineup. The postponement highlights technical challenges in engineering unified, multi-segment Body-in-White platforms across diverse vehicle classes.

biw_news.title: Maserati’s Next Electric Cars Could Be A Large GT And SUV: Report
biw_news.summary: Maserati's shift toward collaborative EV platform development requires adapting Body-in-White layouts to integrate multi-partner structural components. Engineers must align partner floorpan and battery structure designs with Maserati's strict crash load path and torsional rigidity requirements.
